en.headline: Father arrested after nine-year-old girl injured in Tuen Mun knife incident
en.dek: Police said a man was taken in for investigation after his nine-year-old daughter was injured in the chest while he tried to take a knife from her early on Saturday at On Ting Estate.
body: Police said a man was arrested on suspicion of wounding after his nine-year-old daughter was injured early on Saturday at On Ting Estate in Tuen Mun.

Officers received a report at 4.39 am from a man who said his daughter had become agitated inside a flat at On Tai House and was holding a knife. He said he tried to take the knife from her and that she was injured in the chest during the struggle.

The girl was conscious when taken by ambulance to Tuen Mun Hospital. Police classified the case as wounding and took the man to a police station for investigation. No further details on the girl’s condition or the circumstances were immediately available.

zh.headline: 屯門安定邨9歲女童持刀 父奪刀時傷及女兒 涉傷人被捕
zh.dek: 警方稱，今日凌晨一名男子在安定邨嘗試從女兒手中奪刀時，9歲女童胸口受傷送院，案件暫列傷人。
body: 警方表示，今日凌晨在屯門安定邨接獲報案，一名9歲女童在家中情緒激動並手持利刀，其父上前奪刀期間女童胸口受傷。
事發約凌晨4時39分，安定邨定泰樓一名男子報稱其女兒在單位內情緒激動並持刀。他嘗試奪刀制止，期間疑不慎傷及女兒胸口。女童神智清醒，由救護車送往屯門醫院治理。
警方將案件暫列傷人，並將該名男子帶返警署調查。女童傷勢及事件詳情仍有待進一步了解。
